item.title: Ransomware investigation publishes defensive detection research
item.description: Security researchers publish reproducible malware analysis, affected versions and defensive mitigation documentation. The investigation distinguishes observed exploitation from a proof of concept. No claim is made about the reader's environment.

item.title: Cryptography research demonstrates a new security verification technique
item.description: A security research paper supplies methodology and reproducible documentation. This is a research demonstration with limitations, rather than an observed attack.

item.title: AI agent prompt injection research tests security boundaries
item.description: A reproducible security paper on agent prompt injection includes documentation and benchmark results. It discusses mitigation and limitations.
